{
  "pros": [
    "Extremely feature-rich, attempts to be an all-in-one solution.",
    "High level of customization for workflows, views, and statuses.",
    "Flexible and adaptable for various team sizes and project types.",
    "Good value for money, especially compared to competitors.",
    "Frequent updates and continuous release of new features.",
    "Strong integration capabilities with many other popular tools."
  ],
  "cons": [
    "Can be overwhelming due to vast features; steep learning curve.",
    "Performance issues, often reported as slow or buggy.",
    "Overly complex for simple project management needs.",
    "Notification system can be overwhelming or hard to manage.",
    "Inconsistent user interface and user experience across sections.",
    "Frequent updates sometimes introduce new bugs or changes."
  ],
  "overall_rating": 4.2
}
